verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video generation product, so building a custom avatar of a real person is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: character references, facial-expression transfer, and transforming people into new characters. Nothing documents a custom real-person avatar or any consent and verification flow.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
